name: Add onboarding screen for a first run
description:
When rowbly runs for the first time, we should present the user with an onboarding screen

- One screen is shown when rowbly is started for the first time. This is keyed off the users `.rowblyrc.json` in thier home folder.
- For the global onboarding we ask the user for their name and any projects they want to include right away.


- The other screen is on a per-data-root basis.
- Config for this is stored in teh data root and determines if it opens.
- Data root will ask the user how they plan on using rowbly, either as a plain Kanban, a Software Factory or both.
- From there will ask them to create their first board, then whether they want any plugins enabled.
- If software factory plugin is enabled, we guide them through what they need to do for stage prompts, skills, etc.
- Also ask if they plan on using AI (in general, different from software factory) on the project. If they say yes then we guide them through installing default skills + how they can create their own skills.
